call_points.text: InfoBeans achieved seven consecutive quarters of over 6% sequential operating revenue growth.
EBITDA margin returned to a steady state of 24% in Q2FY27, from 23% last quarter.
Management declined to give full-year revenue or EBITDA guidance, citing only sustained growth momentum and a healthy order pipeline.
Hiring net additions are guided at 10-15% for the year, well below the 30% revenue growth rate, as AI improves delivery efficiency.
The company is scouting ServiceNow or AI/data acquisitions in the $5-15 million revenue range with overseas customers and India delivery, but no deal is signed.
Management said it prefers reinvesting cash into the business over returning it, and is not a company to look at for dividend yields.
Trade receivables rose as some clients extended terms from 60 to 90 days and delayed payments; management called these long-standing clients and not a risk.
The company obtained Claude Select Services partner status from Anthropic, with more than a dozen certified cloud developers.
Revenue mix is balanced across geographies: USA 49%, Europe 40%, UAE 8% and rest of the world including India about 3%.
The company is not visa dependent, with less than 50 of its almost 1,900 people across the three overseas geographies.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹141.82 Cr (+37.4% YoY), net profit ₹21.44 Cr (+104.2% YoY).

H1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹316.01 Cr, net profit ₹47.88 Cr.
